# Graft CMS for this Astro app

Shared schema and MDX live in `@andy-portfolio/content` (`packages/content`).
See that package's `llms.txt` and `graft.config.ts`.

- Compile: `bun run --filter=@andy-portfolio/content compile`
- Reads: `src/lib/graft.ts`
- Blog bodies: Astro content collections + `@astrojs/mdx` (glob points at the
  shared `content/posts` directory)
